qualifications: Ratios compare identical task/seed/sample/target/budget within a declared mode; no cross-target or cross-budget factor is used.

Pooled opportunity cost is sum(inclusive CPU)/sum(distinct completed proof opportunities), retaining post-budget work and all misses. In-budget opportunities/hits are separately reported completion-time prefixes, not a claim that the complete run consumes at most B inclusive CPU.

Inclusive here excludes native verification/admission observer intervals and excludes global public-material construction and final native-context/tempdir teardown; it is not complete whole-host CPU or joules.
Each fixed short group has 8 paired cohorts (seeds 101,202 and samples 0..3); long target0f groups have 4 (seed303, samples0..3).
Best supported fixed arm means post-hoc minimum of these finite cohort aggregates, not an executed adaptive decision or a universal cheapest producer.

Per-cohort proof/opportunity/winner sums across alternative algorithms are counterfactual observations; same semantic work recurs across arms and is not additive chainweight or independent hash trials.

Fullrank cold generic seed202/sample0 retains a slow prepare observation totaling18574669ns with only1 proof; it materially affects pooled comparisons, so paired median/range are retained without deleting it.

Auxiliary work count200 is per-cohort observation count, not200 globally distinct tickets. Direct deduplication of retained native_context_acquisition records yields14 globally distinct auxiliary semantic IDs and14 block IDs.

All128285 research proof attempts have native verifier-reported full relation success; only84 outcome-selected representatives were independently replayed in Python. This does not independently verify every reported attempt.
No universal kappa, ASIC/GPU resistance, physical energy lower bound or proof of minimum work cost is established.
